_about: Why SEA-LION suggestions were not applied as written (triage on 29 Oct 2026). Lines not listed here were applied, sometimes lightly adjusted.

id.ui.toQuiz: Style only; SEA-LION itself says the draft is acceptable.
id.quiz[5].explain: "Kata tidak" is not natural Indonesian; "Tolak" (refuse) is clear.
id.feedback.csatLabels[2]: "Cukup puas" leans positive; the middle of the scale should be neutral.

tl.ui.spotPrompt: English loanwords are not pluralised after a number in Tagalog.
tl.ui.earnedBefore: Suggestion drops "you"; the meaning becomes unclear.
tl.ui.retry: "Subukan ulit ang save" is clumsy; "I-save ulit" is clear.
tl.learn[2].todo[1]: Kept "(caning)": the Tagalog alone may not read as a court sentence.
tl.quiz[1].cards[1].text: "Kakapadala" already means "just sent"; SEA-LION misread it.
tl.feedback.learnedOptions[2].label: "Wala" pairs naturally with "Kaunti" for "Did you learn anything new?".

vi.quiz[1].cards[0].from: "Chủ nhà" means homeowner; most attendees are not domestic workers.
vi.quiz[4].msg.bubbles[0][0].t: Same: "chủ nhà" fits domestic workers only.
vi.feedback.csatQuestion: "Buổi học" means a class; this is an event.

zh.ui.closeReview: "关闭查看" is awkward; the review screen shows answers.
zh.ui.attempt: Shown before a number ("尝试次数 2"), so the draft reads correctly.
zh.learn[0].tagline: Kept 人力部 once so readers know what MOM is.
zh.learn[0].chat.lines[2]: Applied through the 应用程序 to 应用 change.
zh.learn[0].todo[0]: "About your work" is in the English; SEA-LION was wrong.
zh.learn[1].tagline: Applied through the 应用程序 to 应用 change.
zh.quiz[5].explain: Keeps the polite 您 used everywhere else.
zh.feedback.learnedOptions[0].label: 有/没有 is the natural answer to "学到…了吗".
zh.feedback.learnedOptions[2].label: Same as above.

th.ui.scam: "มิจฉาชีพ" means scammer (a person); the button labels a message as a scam.
th.ui.attempt: Shown before a number ("ครั้งที่ 2"), so the ordinal is correct.
th.feedback.learnedOptions[0].label: "ได้/ไม่ได้" is the natural answer to "ได้เรียนรู้…ไหม".
th.feedback.learnedOptions[2].label: Same as above.

ta.ui.exitQuiz: Longer label would not fit the top bar on small phones.
ta.ui.tryAgain: Used a shorter correct form, "மீண்டும் முயலுங்கள்", to fit the result screen.
ta.quiz[4].msg.bubbles[2][0].t: Longer wording made the message overflow on a 360px screen.
ta.feedback.csatLabels[0]: Short scale labels are normal; longer ones risk the layout.

my.ui.exitQuiz: Longer label would not fit the top bar on small phones.
my.ui.toQuiz: Other labels use ဉာဏ်စမ်း for "quiz"; changing one breaks consistency.
my.ui.review: Button labels ending in ရန် are common; style only.
my.quiz[0].msg.bubbles[1][0].t: The colon leads into the web address that follows.
my.quiz[3].options[1].label: Keeps the same register as the other two options.
my.feedback.csatLabels[2]: Keeps the same form as the other scale labels.
my.feedback.learnedOptions[0].label: "Learned / did not learn" answers the question directly.
my.feedback.learnedOptions[2].label: Same as above.

hi.event.title: Kept the gloss (धोखाधड़ी) for readers who do not know "स्कैम".
hi.event.intro: "क्विज़ देना" is the correct idiom for taking a quiz (like "परीक्षा देना").

bn.event.title: Kept the gloss (স্ক্যাম) for readers who know the English word.
bn.ui.finish: Used "শেষ করুন" (finish, as an action), shorter than the suggestion.
bn.ui.left: "স্মারক" alone can read as "memorial"; "স্মারক উপহার" is clearer.
bn.feedback.csatQuestion: "খুশি" (happy) is plainer than "সন্তুষ্ট" and matches the English.
